cards.ex: She's been down since she failed her exam.
cards.exUz: U imtihondan yiqilganidan beri tushkun kayfiyatda.
cards.uzDef: Kayfiyati yo'q, xafa bo'lib turmoq.

cards.ex: I tried to cheer her up with flowers, but it didn't work.
cards.exUz: Men uni gullar bilan xursand qilishga harakat qildim, lekin foydasi bo'lmadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir xursand qilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Don't get so worked up about the interview; just relax.
cards.exUz: Intervyu haqida bunchalik hayajonlanmang, shunchaki dam oling.
cards.uzDef: Juda xavotirda yoki hayajonlangan holatda.

cards.ex: I totally freaked out when I saw the spider.
cards.exUz: Men o'rgimchakni ko'rganimda butunlay vahimaga tushdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqib ketish yoki stressga tushish.

cards.ex: Just calm down and tell me what happened.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki tinchlaning va nima bo'lganini ayting.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni xotirjam holatga keltirish.

cards.ex: It's not healthy to bottle up your feelings.
cards.exUz: His-tuyg'ularingizni ichingizga yutishingiz sog'lom emas.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ularni yashirish, ifodalamaslik.

cards.ex: I go for a run to let off steam after a long day.
cards.exUz: Men uzoq kundan keyin g'azabimni chiqarish uchun yuguraman.
cards.uzDef: G'azab yoki stressni biror narsa orqali chiqarib yuborish.

cards.ex: I've been on edge all day waiting for the results.
cards.exUz: Men natijalarni kutib butun kun asabiy bo'lib yurdim.
cards.uzDef: Asabiy yoki xavotirda bo'lish.

cards.ex: It was a long time ago; you need to get over it.
cards.exUz: Bu ancha oldin edi; siz uni unutishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yomon narsani unutishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He took his failure really hard.
cards.exUz: U mag'lubiyatini juda og'ir qabul qildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yomon narsani juda qayg'u bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: I have a gut feeling that something's wrong.
cards.exUz: Menda nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligi haqida ichki sezgi bor.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday dalilsiz, lekin kuchli his qilish.

cards.ex: I have mixed feelings about leaving my job.
cards.exUz: Men ishimni tashlab ketish haqida aralash hislarga egaman.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaqtning o'zida xursand va xafa bo'lish.

cards.ex: He lied, and now he has to face the music.
cards.exUz: U yolg'on gapirdi va endi javob berishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xatolar uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: It makes my blood boil when people are rude.
cards.exUz: Odamlar qo'pol bo'lganida, bu mening jahlimni chiqaradi.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablantiradigan narsa.

cards.ex: I had to bite my tongue to avoid arguing with him.
cards.exUz: Men u bilan bahslashmaslik uchun indamay turishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir aytishni xohlasangiz ham, o'zingizni tiyish.

cards.ex: I cried my eyes out watching that movie.
cards.exUz: Men o'sha filmni tomosha qilib ko'z yosh to'kdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p yig'lamoq.

cards.ex: Just take it easy; everything will be alright.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki vaziyatni oson qabul qiling, hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tinch va oson qabul qilish.

cards.ex: He flies off the handle at the slightest provocation.
cards.exUz: U eng kichik provokatsiyada ham g'azablanadi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga juda g'azablanib ketish.

cards.ex: I had to keep it together during the funeral.
cards.exUz: Men dafn marosimida o'zimni tutishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni nazorat qilib turish, his-tuyg'ularingizni yashirish.

cards.ex: I'm at my wit's end trying to fix this problem.
cards.exUz: Men bu muammoni hal qilishga urinib boshim qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Nima qilishni bilmaydigan holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I always get butterflies in my stomach before a presentation.
cards.exUz: Men har doim taqdimotdan oldin hayajonlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bo'lishidan oldin asabiylashish.

cards.ex: I jumped for joy when I heard the news.
cards.exUz: Men yangilikni eshitganimda quvonchdan sakrab o'ynadim.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand bo'lganingizda sakrab o'ynash.

cards.ex: Hold your horses! Let's think about this first.
cards.exUz: Shoshilmang! Keling, avval bu haqda o'ylab ko'raylik.
cards.uzDef: Sabr qilishni so'rash, shoshilmaslikni talab qilish.

cards.ex: Opera is not really my cup of tea.
cards.exUz: Opera menga unchalik yoqmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sizga qiziq emas yoki yoqmaydi.

cards.ex: I'm sick and tired of your complaints.
cards.exUz: Men sizning shikoyatlaringizdan zerikdim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir juda zerikkan yoki g'azablangan.

cards.ex: I can't help it; I'm just a worrier.
cards.exUz: Qo'limdan kelmaydi; men shunchaki xavotirlanuvchiman.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni nazorat qila olmasligingizni aytish.

cards.ex: I went to the gym to blow off some steam.
cards.exUz: Men stressdan qutulish uchun sport zaliga bordim.
cards.uzDef: Stress yoki g'azabdan qutulish uchun ishlamoq.

cards.ex: We had a blast at the party last night.
cards.exUz: Biz kecha kechada juda hursandchilik qildik.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq, quvonmoq.

cards.ex: You have to take what he says with a grain of salt.
cards.exUz: Uning gapini shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni to'liq ishonch bilan qabul qilmaslik.

cards.ex: It's a weight off my shoulders knowing the project is finished.
cards.exUz: Loyiha tugaganini bilish mening yelkamdan yukni oldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir muammoni hal qilgandan keyin yengillik hissi.
